title: Toolkit: Text Stats
prompt: Build analyze(text) returning a dict with keys words (word count), longest (the longest word — ties: the EARLIEST), and upper (the text in uppercase). Print analyze(sample) for sample = \"Code Journey teaches real Python skills\" as three lines: words / longest / upper value.

tests.name: stats computed
tests.code:
result_keys = ["words", "longest", "upper"]
assert len(printed) == 3, f"print three lines, got {printed}"
assert printed[0] == "6", f"word count, got {printed}"
assert printed[1] == "Journey", f"longest word (earliest tie), got {printed}"
assert printed[2] == "CODE JOURNEY TEACHES REAL PYTHON SKILLS", f"upper, got {printed}"
assert "def analyze" in code, "write analyze(text)"
tests.hint: max(words, key=len) returns the FIRST longest on ties; .upper() for the shout.
